## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `IdeTroubleshooting`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `ide-troubleshooting`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **IdeTroubleshooting**.

## Step 2: 1. Enable verbose logging

1. <!-- manual: Open Settings with Cmd+, on macOS, or Ctrl+, on Windows and Linux. -->
2. Search for `ballerina`.
3. <!-- manual: Set each of the following to the value shown: -->
4. <!-- manual: ballerina.traceLog: enabled (true). -->
5. <!-- manual: ballerina.debugLog: enabled (true). -->
6. <!-- manual: ballerina-vscode.trace.server: verbose. -->

## Step 3: 2. Open the output panel

1. <!-- manual: Press Cmd+Shift+P on macOS, or Ctrl+Shift+P on Windows and Linux. -->
2. <!-- manual: Run Output: Focus on Output View. -->
3. In the channel dropdown on the right of the Output panel, select **Ballerina**.
